# `sec_reported_facts`

**SEC reported financial observations**

Every selected companyfacts observation, preserving units, periods, fiscal context and accessions.

**Coverage.** Window. Explicit CIK cohort and date/concept selection only. SEC submissions continuation inventories are checked for the filing-date window. Companyfacts covers standard-taxonomy whole-entity facts; custom taxonomies, original XBRL contextRef and dimensional detail are outside this API scope. Comparative reports and amendments remain separate observations. The generation evidence records the selection; no publisher-wide completeness is inferred. *(measured 2026-11-13)*

- **Parquet file:** `sec_reported_facts.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cik` | `VARCHAR` | SEC Central Index Key, zero-padded to ten digits. Stable issuer identity; tickers are descriptive metadata. |
| `taxonomy` | `VARCHAR` | Source taxonomy name; no cross-taxonomy equivalence is inferred. |
| `concept` | `VARCHAR` | Native XBRL concept tag; interpreted only within taxonomy and unit. |
| `unit` | `VARCHAR` | Literal source unit key, including ratios such as USD/shares. Never silently converted or combined. |
| `value_text` | `VARCHAR` | Exact numeric value as decimal text; original bytes preserve number spelling. NULL requires value_status. |
| `value_status` | `VARCHAR` | reported or json_null; a missing fact is a separate query/scope outcome. |
| `period_kind` | `VARCHAR` | instant when start is absent, duration when start is a date, unknown when start is explicit null. |
| `period_start` | `VARCHAR` | Reported duration start. NULL covers instant or unknown; consult period_kind and context_json. |
| `period_end` | `VARCHAR` | Reported end/instant date. Selection uses this date, not fiscal-year labels. |
| `accession` | `VARCHAR` | Literal filing accession, kept separate for originals and amendments. |
| `form` | `VARCHAR` | Source form code, including /A amendments. |
| `is_amendment` | `BOOLEAN` | Whether the source form ends in /A. Does not infer which accession is replaced. |
| `filed_date` | `VARCHAR` | Date of the filing that reports this observation; later comparative observations remain separate. |
| `fiscal_year` | `INTEGER` | Publisher fiscal year (fy), describing filing context rather than substituting for period dates. |
| `fiscal_period` | `VARCHAR` | Publisher fiscal period (fp); separate from actual duration dates. |
| `frame` | `VARCHAR` | Optional publisher calendar frame. Missing/null remain visible in context_json; frames do not define equal periods. |
| `label` | `VARCHAR` | Publisher concept label, when supplied. |
| `description` | `VARCHAR` | Publisher concept description, when supplied. |
| `context_json` | `VARCHAR` | Complete API observation, including unknown fields; decimal values are exact text. Original XBRL contextRef/dimensions are not supplied by companyfacts. |
| `observation_id` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 of original response digest plus JSON Pointer. Competing and duplicate native positions remain distinct. |
| `filing_url` | `VARCHAR` | Official accession index locator. Link retention does not establish downloaded filing-body content. |
| `source_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 of the retained original response. A capture identity, not a publisher release date. |
| `source_url` | `VARCHAR` | Exact official SEC JSON locator. |
| `observed_at` | `VARCHAR` | Original capture instant; not the filing date or financial period. |
| `source_pointer` | `VARCHAR` | JSON Pointer into the retained original. A filing pointer identifies its accession in compact arrays; matching indexes locate other columns. |
